template:
You review a parsed resume profile for applicant-tracking-system (ATS) readiness.

Parsed profile: {{profile}}

Return valid JSON with exactly these keys:
- score (number 0-100)
- issues (array of {severity: "high" | "medium" | "low", section (one of: contact, summary, skills, experience, education, formatting), issue, fix (concrete, actionable)})

Rules: only flag issues visible in the parsed profile; every fix must be something the candidate can do; do not invent content the candidate should add beyond structural guidance.
